query:
-- The plan of the production statement of the same name in src/persistence/queries.
-- persistence/plans.rs checks that everything after this header is that statement.
EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON)
-- The tenant's acquired releases after a cursor position, seeking the primary key past it.
SELECT
    tenant AS "tenant: TenantId",
    release_key AS "release_key: AuthorityReleaseId",
    owner AS "owner: PrincipalId",
    source_key AS "source_key: TimeSourceId",
    dataset_kind AS "dataset_kind: TimeDatasetKind",
    state AS "state: TimeAuthorityReleaseState",
    version_label,
    source_url,
    source_digest,
    artifact_path,
    retrieved_at,
    validated_at,
    body,
    record_version,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    tenant_key,
    owner_key,
    work_context
FROM time.authority_release
WHERE tenant = $1 AND release_key > $2
ORDER BY release_key
LIMIT $3
